Imprint, privacy and terms of use.

Provider: TechFlipsi / Fabian Kirchweger, Marktplatz 11/3, 4625 Offenhausen, Austria.

Scope: development and provision of the FlipsiBridge app — a tool for remote-controlling your own Android device via a relay server you run yourself.

Authorized representative: Fabian Kirchweger.

Controller: TechFlipsi / Fabian Kirchweger, Marktplatz 11/3, 4625 Offenhausen, Austria.

Data processed: the app only handles the data the bridge needs — server address, pairing code, connection and device status, plus the messages you write and actions you order. Chat content and history stay on the device.

Server operator: FlipsiBridge connects only to the relay server you set up yourself. Whoever operates that server is responsible for processing on it; the app sends no data to any TechFlipsi server.

Encryption: end-to-end encryption is built into the app (Settings → Encryption); whether it is active depends on your server and client configuration.

Your rights (Art 15–21 GDPR): access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection — in writing to the address above. You may also lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority.

Legal basis: contract performance or your explicit consent (Art 6 (1) (b) and (a) GDPR). No profiling or automated decision-making takes place.

Use: FlipsiBridge is provided free of charge for private use.

Warranty: the app is provided as is; statutory warranty is excluded to the extent legally permissible.

Liability: TechFlipsi is liable only for intent and gross negligence and for personal injury. No liability for damage caused by improper use, third-party systems or data loss.

Your duties: use the app only on devices you own or are authorized to use, and within applicable law.

Changes: these terms may change; the current version lives in the app under Settings → About.
Support button: support the app with a one-time donation
